Package SHA256: 782923F4AB3ABCDA4AD6E54563D3C9DE8A83955DB04481520E6AD3A48EDDC3B7

The package was extracted with the installed WinRAR.
The headers are from the package's include directory.
lib/libeasyxw.a is from lib_mingw_ucrt/x64 (Unicode, UCRT, 64-bit).
The original package readme is included as readme.txt.

VS Code uses these project-local files through .vscode/tasks.json and
.vscode/c_cpp_properties.json. The compiler installation is not modified.
